# TNO-Tensura-Compat — complete historical archive

This archive preserves the available repository history from its first commit through the committed NEB checkpoint and the current local Mowzie callback checkpoint. It combines phase narratives, all-target coverage, research discoveries, implementation/validation chronology, exact artifact pins, a complete evidence-file index and the full reachable commit chronicle.

It is a repository-evidence archive. Unknown founding context, unrecorded test runs, unrecovered original artifact identities and unretained runtime captures stay unknown. Historical conclusions retain their dates/scopes and are distinguished from later accepted corrections. Exact per-shot/per-method details remain in the indexed native/capture files.

## 1. Project origin and initial scope

The earliest reachable commit is **953fd1f89fc2460cbe23fe5b11a5afd8706ece91**, dated **2026-08-22**, subject “Initial TNO Tensura Compat project.” The repository is not shallow. Its initial commit adds 15 files / 834 insertions: a NeoForge/Gradle template, CI build workflow, metadata, wrapper, README and the Java mod entrypoint. This is the beginning of the available Git history; earlier private discussion, experiments or project planning are **unknown**.

The initial mod identifier is `tno_tensura_compat`, name “TNO Tensura Compat,” version 0.1.0, Java package/group `com.tno.tensuracompat`. The README remains template installation documentation. It does not record a complete founding design brief. The creator’s personal motivation, the expansion of “TNO,” any pre-repository Phase 1–5E history, and the reason the first benchmark phase is numbered 5F are **not established by this repository**.

The first concrete compatibility scope is visible in the next two commits:

## 2. Major phase timeline

Dates in this section are Git dates unless the report supplies an experiment date. Checkpoint letters/numbers belong to their named phase; for example, production 6A–6F, native-path E1–E3 and catalog R2o are distinct sequences. The complete commit chronicle later in this archive preserves every reachable research-branch commit and changed implementation path.

### 2.1 Phase 5F — benchmark plan, controlled Apotheosis and suite instrumentation (2026-08-25–29)

**Need and attempt.** The recorded goal was to test three independent suites against Tensura/NEB bosses with L2 Hostility: Apotheosis only, TNO only, and the legal combination. The plan sought measurable Stage progression while preserving boss/L2 defenses. It did not authorize balance changes.

**Implementation.** The plan begins at [7db47dacce685e9481e56996a22d5760edae8a7f](https://github.com/pooofeeee/TNO-Tensura-Compat/commit/7db47dacce685e9481e56996a22d5760edae8a7f). Runtime inspectors, the Apotheosis harness, suite A/B harnesses and strict PowerShell extractors preserve native projectile ownership, source identity, legal gear/trait provenance and per-event accounting. Controlled neutral screening compares seven Apotheosis profiles and promotes by averaged critical damage. The accepted Ancient single-Prosperous-Spectral profile retains legal affixes/gems and actual extra spectral projectiles.

**Evidence and results.**

| Scope | Closure commit | Recorded accepted result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Apotheosis controlled benchmark | [035de3e481265d3a9ad6c3d8c84592442743a711](https://github.com/pooofeeee/TNO-Tensura-Compat/commit/035de3e481265d3a9ad6c3d8c84592442743a711) | Exact live equipment/affix/rarity audit and screened neutral results retained in the Phase 5F plan. |
| Suite A, APO-only seven bosses | [eccdd51d205c5b5bbec2b67b884d38701ba99044](https://github.com/pooofeeee/TNO-Tensura-Compat/commit/eccdd51d205c5b5bbec2b67b884d38701ba99044) | 41 cases / 409 per-shot rows / zero case errors. |
| Suite B Magic/Holy/Soul | [fd5a78c1001284fa5f2fc8120d2ee108e86c39a9](https://github.com/pooofeeee/TNO-Tensura-Compat/commit/fd5a78c1001284fa5f2fc8120d2ee108e86c39a9) | 21 artifacts / 1,107 cases / 11,070 rows. Each family: 369 cases / 3,690 rows. |
| Suite B Elemental | [e20c219b664fd4f9e3f845bf5b0d2470a73eeac2](https://github.com/pooofeeee/TNO-Tensura-Compat/commit/e20c219b664fd4f9e3f845bf5b0d2470a73eeac2) | 369 cases / 3,690 rows; representative Earth path. |
| Suite B Energy | [e6e4c9c1cc29efe9bb1f035e79566079a9de38f7](https://github.com/pooofeeee/TNO-Tensura-Compat/commit/e6e4c9c1cc29efe9bb1f035e79566079a9de38f7) | 369 cases / 3,690 rows; native current-pool drains, no DamageSource. |

The seven targets were Luminous, Hinata, Gazel, Orc Disaster, Elemental Colossus, Carrion and Rimuru Ogre Fight. Natural representative/max levels and explicitly labeled stress levels preserve different legality scopes. Blocked/zero native outcomes remain results, not reasons to fabricate alternate hits.

The initial reports described missing ordinary Soul events and severe apparent Elemental/Severance suppression. Later native-path and ticking studies correct specific causal interpretations; the old captures remain historical evidence.

Sources: `docs/phase-5f-l2-apotheosis-benchmark.md` and the Suite A/B README, JSONL and strict extractor files.

### 2.2 Phase 5F — dedicated L2 traits and legal combined Suite C (2026-08-28–29)

**Need.** Natural rolls alone could not test all live traits, and valid APO/TNO coexistence required a legal combined item and per-projectile accounting.

**Changes.** `Phase5FL2TraitMatrix` adds catalog, natural and forced diagnostic modes. Forced illegal traits are explicitly compatibility diagnostics. Suite C replaces only incompatible Barrier Piercing with the active native TNO family Engraving while retaining the legal Ancient APO build.

A benchmark defect initially left a callback-dispatched projectile alive, allowing its next-tick second collision. The corrected harness discards only the projectile whose legitimate callback completed and validates UUID uniqueness; genuine extra spectral entities remain independent. This is a harness correction.

**Results.** The natural trait matrix covers seven bosses × ten levels = 70 profiles, zero errors and full legality coverage for 39 live traits; 26 appear naturally, Arena is legal but absent from this finite sample, and 12 are entity-rejected. The forced Luminous matrix has 110 native rank cases across all 39 traits; targeted Orc diagnostics cover 33 ranks.

Suite C closes with 48 artifacts, 2,298 cases and 22,044 rows, zero case errors: 42 direct artifacts / 2,214 cases / 21,204 rows plus six strongest-legal endgame artifacts / 84 cases / 840 rows. The evidence distinguishes legal extra projectiles, family events, residual physical damage and Stage scaling.

**Milestones.** Trait closure [fc8bc715549c583cb7da395ef60190d66d3ddbea](https://github.com/pooofeeee/TNO-Tensura-Compat/commit/fc8bc715549c583cb7da395ef60190d66d3ddbea); Suite C closure [c3c36b4863f724aff504c2df126f86aa21b9fe32](https://github.com/pooofeeee/TNO-Tensura-Compat/commit/c3c36b4863f724aff504c2df126f86aa21b9fe32). Full strict extraction and live legality details remain in `docs/benchmarks/phase5f-l2-traits/README.md` and `docs/benchmarks/phase5f-suite-c/README.md`.

### 2.5 Post-Phase-6 viability and Magic/Holy calibration (2026-09-03–04)

**Need.** Valid Stage math did not establish practical high-level damage against L2 generic health, Dementor, Adaptive and native healing.

**Attempts.** [0cc6005580725f9ecc860163b72987bf29a8f759](https://github.com/pooofeeee/TNO-Tensura-Compat/commit/0cc6005580725f9ecc860163b72987bf29a8f759) documents endgame viability research. Calibration A–I separately examines durability, source classification, a production-disabled synchronous scope, all-100% diagnostic ceiling, generic-health Q, Dementor RD, Adaptive RA, combined candidates and lower-level/family safety.

**Discoveries.** L2 native vanilla-HP scaling and its 10,000 attribute ceiling differ from SHP; the external Tensura:L2Hostility datapack separately adds 3% native SHP per level. Magic/Holy sources bypass armor but lack NeoForge IS_MAGIC, so Dementor applies and Dispell does not. Q alone cannot resolve the retained reducers. Candidate calibration projections are not observed sustained kills.

The development calibration code uses a transient scope, existing L2 attachment only and fail-closed gates. The safety matrix preserves physical/APO damage, other families, native admission and source identities.

**Result.** Calibration closes at [7c968e3e811f791e9040806de4059c0bfb0591a2](https://github.com/pooofeeee/TNO-Tensura-Compat/commit/7c968e3e811f791e9040806de4059c0bfb0591a2). Native-source-preserving Stage-only Q/RD/RA is selected for the two-family production task; no arbitrary L2 level threshold or global L2 bypass is justified.

Sources: `docs/phase-6-endgame-viability-research.md`, `docs/phase-6-endgame-effectiveness-calibration.md`, their README/JSONL/analysis artifacts, and `Phase6CalibrationContext` tests.

### 2.6 Magic/Holy endgame production (2026-09-04)

**Implementation.** P1–P6 adds `MagicHolyEndgamePolicy`, `L2HealthScaling`, `L2HostilityTargetAdapter`, `MagicHolyEndgameContext`, `MagicHolyEndgameL2Bridge` and the narrow AdditionalDamage mixin boundary. Production has no calibration/debug-state dependency.

| Stage | Q (generic H) | RD (Dementor) | RA (Adaptive) |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| S0–S4 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| S5 | 0.50 | 0.500 | 0.500 |
| S6 | 0.75 | 0.625 | 0.625 |
| S7 | 1.00 | 0.750 | 0.750 |

H reads L2’s live linear/exponential level/health configuration and entity health scale. `N = 1 + Q*(H-1)` does not use realized HP, SHP, Tank or Regenerate as the generic health term. Optional L2 and missing context fail closed. Recovery applies only to selected loss inside actual native admitted Magic/Holy events.

**Validation.** P5 preserves 86 cases / 860 real releases, each with one physical and one native family event, zero duplication/recursion/unexpected bypass, APO NONE and calibration mode absent. Optional-L2 startup and focused unit/build checks are recorded. Production starts at [4ed4c9adf73ba6b7fa613708e2a7bd5912124870](https://github.com/pooofeeee/TNO-Tensura-Compat/commit/4ed4c9adf73ba6b7fa613708e2a7bd5912124870) and closes at [e3fa6809381d8100c8b2baee180e6bb606570fae](https://github.com/pooofeeee/TNO-Tensura-Compat/commit/e3fa6809381d8100c8b2baee180e6bb606570fae).

Source: `docs/phase-6-endgame-magic-holy-production.md` and `docs/benchmarks/phase6-endgame-magic-holy-production/README.md`.

### 2.7 Severance/Regenerate R1–R5 (2026-09-04–05)

**Question.** Does native Severance constrain L2 Regenerate, and what explains poor sustained progress?

**Evidence and changes.** Exact installed native bytecode plus controlled heal/physical/wound observations establish a hard vanilla-HP ceiling `maxHP - wound`. It is not proportional reduction of Regenerate’s nominal rate. Development-only eligible-contribution prototypes preserve source and native wound ownership; they do not become permanent production.

R3/R4 originally interpreted missed pre-DamageData outcomes as unreliable native admission. R5 guarantees ticking and accepts 360/360 Severance arrows/callbacks in 18 cases / 1,080 releases. It supersedes that rejection attribution with a harness-ticking explanation, while preserving valid admitted magnitude/source evidence.

**Result.** Native constraint works, but realized post-mitigation deficit limits wound growth and sustained progress. Current-scale late progress is about 0.166945 HP/s in the selected strongest legal profile; the approximately 16.64-hour HP-only extrapolation is conditional, not an observed kill. SHP progress is not demonstrated. Closure: [571736da7c4de3e30038b0778a5351da6ace3b26](https://github.com/pooofeeee/TNO-Tensura-Compat/commit/571736da7c4de3e30038b0778a5351da6ace3b26).

Source: `docs/phase-6-severance-regenerate-research.md` and its native audits, R2–R5 raw captures and strict validation.

### 2.8 W1–W4 adaptive wound architecture and P1–P4 native counter protocol (2026-09-05–06)

**Need.** Determine whether a narrow wound-only Adaptive negotiation is semantically defensible, and ensure Regenerate remains a real native hard counter.

W1 identifies Adaptive’s route through realized HP/free-deficit authority. W2 compares A–E architectures; Candidate C partially negotiates only eligible Severance wound credit after Tank/Dementor and is narrower than broad pre-reducer credit or literal ignoreDefence. W3’s production-disabled prototype passes mechanical gates. W4’s “no healing” gate fails at the native ceiling and initially prevents further viability work.

The later P1 formal model distinguishes Regenerate’s below-ceiling, partially filled and at-ceiling states. P2 demonstrates native A/B/C behavior; P3’s ON/OFF dynamic comparisons preserve strong defender advantage. P4 supersedes W4’s false-negative identity gate: correct at-ceiling zero healing is valid Regenerate, and the protocol permits bounded Candidate C viability research.

**Result.** Protocol validity does not select RW or approve production. Counter protocol closure: [0033ecef9f81272adafbbc53fdd33adba9507f2e](https://github.com/pooofeeee/TNO-Tensura-Compat/commit/0033ecef9f81272adafbbc53fdd33adba9507f2e).

Sources: `docs/phase-6-regenerate-adaptive-wound-architecture-research.md` and `docs/phase-6-regenerate-severance-counter-protocol-research.md`, W/P raw captures and `p4-decision.json`.

### 2.9 Candidate C sustained viability V1–V4 (2026-09-06)

The decisive official matrix has 15 cases × 2,400 ticks, 1,800 genuine releases, 1,080 Regenerate cycles and 36,015 trajectory samples. Matched ON/OFF levels and RW=0/0.5/1 preserve native physical Adaptive, Tank, Dementor, one physical source and wound ownership. Strict official extraction, exact recomputation, negative tests and clean build pass.

No ON target dies. Even RW=1 produces only conditional HP projections of roughly 7.84–7.93 hours with zero SHP progress; RW=0/0.5 are weaker. Some OFF targets die with SHP remaining, so HP/SHP cannot be invented as one common kill metric.

Final result: **CANDIDATE_C_REJECTED**, exhausted; no calibrated RW interval, further Candidate-C architecture or production approval. Closure: [b50061eb9040474a7fb8bdeb780f46a30201d63f](https://github.com/pooofeeee/TNO-Tensura-Compat/commit/b50061eb9040474a7fb8bdeb780f46a30201d63f).

Source: `docs/phase-6-candidate-c-sustained-viability-research.md`, `v4-decision.json` and official/raw validation artifacts.

### 2.10 Elemental native-path E1–E3 (2026-09-07–08)

The historical harness dispatched an inherited empty one-argument collision overload, then discarded the projectile. E1 source analysis and E2 same-projectile rescue/native flight establish the legitimate two-argument native tick collision path for Earth, Fire, Space, Water and Wind.

E3 records 90 cases, 75 native source constructions, 71 incoming family events, 46 applied events, 25 matching Nullification denials and four Fire Resistance pre-event denials. There are no duplicate family events or unexpected bypasses. The retained Fire Resistance origin is a narrow unknown; it does not imply innate Orc immunity.

Final result: **HISTORICAL_HARNESS_DISPATCH_DEFECT; NO_PRODUCTION_NATIVE_PATH_FIX_INDICATED**. Closure: [deeb10247883b1825338349b8a6250e39d026a2e](https://github.com/pooofeeee/TNO-Tensura-Compat/commit/deeb10247883b1825338349b8a6250e39d026a2e). Stage and production remain locked; full balance/runtime combinations remain beyond this path study.

Source: `docs/phase-6-elemental-native-event-path-research.md` and E1 audit / E2 capture-validation / E3 decision.

### 2.11 Soul native-path S1–S4 (2026-09-08–09)

Exact native Soul Eater uses an after_attack spiritual operation and SPIRITUAL_HURT_EVENT/SHP storage. Counting only ordinary HP events gave an incorrect absence interpretation; the original 320-row evidence already contains SHP loss.

Two native positive controls and 23 Royal releases preserve 20 Soul callbacks, 16 sources, 12 accepted spiritual events and zero ordinary Soul HP events. Native Spiritual Resistance’s HP/2 gate, source identity, SHP accounting and the retained one Hinata trajectory miss are recorded separately.

Final result: **SOUL_NATIVE_PATH_VALID_NO_FIX**. 54 clean-build tests and strict/corruption validation pass. Closure: [38262bfa99ca4cecd3a2ba58cdb8cc6595893a4c](https://github.com/pooofeeee/TNO-Tensura-Compat/commit/38262bfa99ca4cecd3a2ba58cdb8cc6595893a4c). No production prototype/fix is justified.

Source: `docs/phase-6-soul-native-event-path-research.md` and S1–S4 audits/raw/validation/decision.

### 2.12 Energy native prerequisites ES1–ES4 (2026-09-10)

Energy Steal is a native after_damage current-resource drain: level-I base percentage 0.01, 20-tick cooldown, actual hurt=true prerequisite and no DamageSource. Source construction or an incoming event alone does not prove the operation ran. Target loss and attacker gain can differ at capacity.

ES3b reproduces empty-world entity-tick suspension after emptyTime 300 while the benchmark’s ServerTick.Post releases continue. Target timers freeze, and equal requested damage can return hurt=false before actuallyHurt/after_damage. Five reproduced failures are directly explained; a native ticket restores 20/20 admitted operations. The old 269 absences lack individual return/timer data and remain individually unassigned.

ES4 closes 77 decisive rows with **ENERGY_NATIVE_PATH_VALID_NO_FIX**. Final clean build has 54 tests; evidence corruption suites have 62 negative tests. Closure: [d212695c006f503f1b175e4b9a7a57e2f0ebf5ac](https://github.com/pooofeeee/TNO-Tensura-Compat/commit/d212695c006f503f1b175e4b9a7a57e2f0ebf5ac). No production/L2 bypass or correction.

Source: `docs/phase-6-energy-steal-physical-prerequisite-research.md`, ES1–ES4 native/capture/differential/reassessment/validation files.

### 2.14 External catalog foundation R1/R2a/R2b (2026-09-12)

The owner’s exact original instance is `C:/Users/youra/curseforge/minecraft/Instances/new`. R1 pins all **23/23 requested filenames**, zero unavailable at inventory time; four existing compatibility JARs are separately pinned. SHA-256 identity controls research even when filename and embedded version differ.

R2a scans 22 external outer JARs plus four compatibility candidates: **18,601 parsed classes, zero class parse failures**, 14,662 candidate classes and 85,421 candidate methods. Base Tensura’s accepted six families are reference-only. Six nested archives and nine JSON parsing anomalies are explicitly recorded at that historical checkpoint; individual later mod/resource receipts determine current closure, so those old counts cannot be restated as present unresolved totals.

Pinned Vineflower 1.10.1 readable aids and class/member/instruction indexes support research; failed/decompiler-warning bodies require bytecode follow-up. Large aids/JARs stay outside Git; retained proofs, locators and extraction tools are committed.

R2b establishes raw vanilla prerequisites rather than substituting the patched development loader. The original instance uses NeoForge 21.1.244; mapped development 21.1.248 is a different authority. Gelid freezing, Poison custom-arrow duration, Murk inertia and undead/tag eligibility are examined explicitly.

Milestones: R1 [1a362b65e075177f78792cbad12fb979203f2890](https://github.com/pooofeeee/TNO-Tensura-Compat/commit/1a362b65e075177f78792cbad12fb979203f2890); R2a [2e9d999ca68c101ac26c9e41415a696db7c5f65b](https://github.com/pooofeeee/TNO-Tensura-Compat/commit/2e9d999ca68c101ac26c9e41415a696db7c5f65b); R2b [e380f8a2afce27ec768ec23ae4c6f19b3fb21483](https://github.com/pooofeeee/TNO-Tensura-Compat/commit/e380f8a2afce27ec768ec23ae4c6f19b3fb21483). R2b’s historical allowance/save-mode stop is a handoff condition, not a completion claim or a current research prohibition.

Historical Stage-routing output is superseded as policy authority. The repair receipt preserves 550 native artifacts; 136 changed checkpoint fact sections have zero changed native facts. Thirty-eight targeted tests and final completed-mod validators pass; pinned reproduction of 88 affected classes / 474 method witnesses is BYTE_IDENTICAL. No production, runtime or Stage-policy decision is added.

Large-mod workflow subsequently uses retained immutable census, exact method/equivalence/context proofs, authored semantic batches, consumer-bound numeric audit and explicit resource/dependency obligations. Structural context reduction never supplies semantic meaning on its own.

Selected native discoveries, quoted from the current canonical record:

**`cultofazazel:manipulation`** — `CUSTOM_CONTROL`.

Affected Player: server effect tick when remaining duration%20==0 retargets Piglin/ZombifiedPiglin in AABB20. Amplifier unused. Client local-player event increments angle0.05, yaw+=sin(angle)*0.8, pitch+=cos(angle*0.5)*0.3; enqueues attack clicks with random20..59-tick spacing. Input searches first lava/fire in x/z±10,y±5, not nearest and without pathfinding; look-relative forward/left impulses steer toward it, or random[-1,1) impulses every15 player ticks when none. Static client timers are not reset on cure.

**`cultofazazel:stick_pull`** — `CUSTOM_CONTROL`.

Non-sneaking use with20 durability available samples0.5..15 by0.5; first alive non-user LivingEntity in sampleAABB0.6 gets Manipulation600/0 and velocity(normalizedTowardPlayer.x*1.4,0.4,normalizedTowardPlayer.z*1.4). No block ray occlusion, hurt call or addEffect-success gate for motion; spends20 durability. No ordinary-use cooldown.

Remaining native ambiguities: **0** in the accepted ledger scope. Stage policy, full-pack runtime interactions and unexecuted future fixtures remain outside this static completion. Older provisional family queues and checkpoint-specific “next” instructions are historical and do not reopen the completed review.

Selected native discoveries, quoted from the current canonical record:

**`variantsandventures:poison_payload`** — `VANILLA_DIRECT`.

Thicket calls super.doHurtTarget first, then on success with empty main hand and a LivingEntity target applies vanilla POISON through LivingEntity.addEffect with itself as source. Verdant calls super.getArrow and adds a POISON MobEffectInstance only when the returned projectile is an Arrow. These are separate application paths.

**`variantsandventures:frozen_ticks_set`** — `VANILLA_DIRECT`.

Melee: successful super.doHurtTarget, empty main hand, LivingEntity and canFreeze gates precede setTicksFrozen(240). Snowball: ProjectileHitEvent listener checks Snowball owned by Gelid and a LivingEntity hit, requests 4 damage through the owner's vanilla thrown-source factory, then sets frozen ticks to 240 without checking canFreeze or the hurt return value. Assignment replaces the timer; it does not add 240. This is not a registered freezing MobEffect.

Selected native discoveries, quoted from the current canonical record:

**`twilightforest:lich_shield_resource`** — `CUSTOM_RESOURCE`.

Integer SHIELD_STRENGTH, default6, separate from MAX_HEALTH100. Each accepted break subtracts exactly1, independent of excess amount. Clone getter returns0. Boss bar in phase1 displays shield/current max_shield_strength, not HP.

Synched default6; constructor then stores int(attribute twilightforest:max_shield_strength), default6/range0..1024. clone_count defaults2 and minion_count9 (same attribute range). Constructor copies int(minion_count) to reserve. finalizeSpawn equips Fortification Scepter; it does not grant additional shields. NBT explicitly saves/restores shield/reserve/clone UUIDs/master/baby count/hit counter; missing integer keys read0. Setter has no clamp or native refill.

Only the non-bypassing shield branch with tagged source and raw incoming float amount>2 decrements1. All shield-branch exits return false. A failed tag/amount check may set lastHurtByMob from a Living causing entity; successful break branch does not do that. die can clear shield to0 but is not shield break.

breaks_lich_shields is necessary inside the ordinary shield branch but is NOT sufficient. Exactly five native values: twilightforest:lich_bolt, twilightforest:twilight_scepter, minecraft:magic, minecraft:indirect_magic, minecraft:sonic_boom. Bomb and neoforge:is_magic membership alone do not qualify. BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY skips the shield mechanism and attempts HP damage instead of decrementing.

To break normally: reach Lich.hurt through a legitimate delivery; teleport counter<=0; not a clone; causing entity not any Lich; shield>0; not bypassing invulnerability; tag match; argument strictly>2. No universal Player/direct-projectile/owner/nonally test is present in Lich.hurt. Projectile, potion, fang, Conduit and Warden predicates are separately retained in source_paths. Cloaked Bolt collision is rejected even before hurt.

A shield decrement, including6->5 and1->0, returns false without super.hurt: same request causes no HP loss, no hurt cooldown and no standard successful-hit callback. Separate later requests from one compound delivery can damage HP after1->0: ownerless Wither Skull magic5 can break, then its distinct native explosion request can hit exposed Lich. Multiple fangs/Anvil sweep+AoE similarly remain distinct requests. Damage requests are not measured HP loss.

At1->0 getPhase immediately becomes2 if reserve>0 or owned minion count>0; otherwise3. Default fresh Lich has reserve9, so phase2. No immediate HP damage, forced HP write or forced teleport is performed by shield break. Phase1 goal stops and despawns clones when goal scheduling observes loss of phase1; phase2 equips Zombie Scepter. Bossbar switches to HP on its next update.

### Ice and Fire CE — `iceandfire`

Current ledger status: **COMPLETE**. Exact source: `IceAndFireCE-2.0-beta.15-1.21.1-neoforge.jar`; SHA-256 `93e0b3dae60bdc630431e3e1d7179eca291a55f93704edf631a44418b500875b`. Inventory records 726 archive classes; this is an artifact inventory unit, not a standalone reviewed-method count.

First preserved canonical review: 2026-09-23 at [2031703aa37d2ceb6b82ef1083f9772b8dc4a1df](https://github.com/pooofeeee/TNO-Tensura-Compat/commit/2031703aa37d2ceb6b82ef1083f9772b8dc4a1df). First preserved PARTIAL ledger checkpoint: `R2g1-native-source-foundation` at [2031703aa37d2ceb6b82ef1083f9772b8dc4a1df](https://github.com/pooofeeee/TNO-Tensura-Compat/commit/2031703aa37d2ceb6b82ef1083f9772b8dc4a1df).

Investigated scope: Frozen/weapon companions, Siren/Flute and Gorgon, dragon body/offense/flight/heal/armor, worm/Cyclops/Ghost/Troll, control/equipment and custom DamageType producers.

Current result: **81 records / 228 paths / 0 recorded numeric candidates**. Canonical review: [iceandfire.json](benchmarks/external-effects-catalog/mod-reviews/iceandfire.json). Current checkpoint: `R2g10b-iceandfire-complete`. Closure/current milestone: [74492a5c2ec72051e8c0d142e16542a795aa5029](https://github.com/pooofeeee/TNO-Tensura-Compat/commit/74492a5c2ec72051e8c0d142e16542a795aa5029). Receipt: [iceandfire-r2g10a-closure.json](benchmarks/external-effects-catalog/iceandfire-r2g10a-closure.json).

Native classes/methods reviewed are enumerated by exact entry, method, descriptor/witness and evidence references in the canonical implementations. Retained evidence files directly referenced by implementation: **16**. These are file-reference counts, not independent deep-review counts. Representative exact coordinates:

- `com/iafenvoy/iceandfire/item/ability/FrozenTargetAbility.class` — `active`.
- `com/iafenvoy/iceandfire/item/ability/DamageBonusAbility.class` — `active`.
- `com/iafenvoy/iceandfire/item/tool/ActivePostHitSwordItem.class` — `hurtEnemy`.

Selected native discoveries, quoted from the current canonical record:

**`iaf:frozen`** — `CUSTOM_STATUS`.

iceandfire:frozen is NEUTRAL, not HARMFUL, and requests applyEffectTick every eligible remaining-duration tick. Amplifier is unused. Ordered core: IceDragonEntity or dead/dying returns false; otherwise on fire clears fire then returns false; otherwise creative Player returns true without motion; otherwise multiplies current delta x/z by0.25 preserving y; then non-EnderDragon airborne recipients add y=-0.2; returns true. IceDragon/dead admission occurs before extinguishing. EnderDragon only escapes the extra downward term, not horizontal damping.

The entire Frozen class has no hurt, HP subtraction, freezing-gauge write, attribute modifier registration, setNoAi, movement lock or custom DamageSource. This is repeated velocity modification. Ordinary entity travel/input/gravity later in the tick can change motion again; it does not prove a fixed final speed. Existing Slowness/MiningFatigue in weapon delivery are separate vanilla effects, not effects of Frozen itself.

LivingEntity.baseTick calls tickEffects; LivingEntity.tick calls its Entity superclass tick/baseTick route before aiStep and travel. The callback modifies the velocity present at that point. A Frozen instance can exist on an IceDragon/creative recipient until native processing; the tick branch is not a custom addEffect admission veto.

Frozen producers use ordinary addEffect(instance) which delegates addEffect(instance,null). Native NeoForge Applicable/canBeAffected and installed Manas HEAD interception remain in force. Each boolean is ignored by the producer. An admitted request may merge/update an existing instance or return false on no effective update. Same-amp longer duration refreshes; weaker/higher effects follow native hidden-effect update rules. onEffectStarted is called for admitted add requests even when update returns false; glass placement sound is not proof of a new stored status.

Exact installed MobEffectInstance.tick on applyEffectTick=false calls entity.removeEffect(holder), ignores its boolean, then ticks duration and hidden state; it does not zero the duration. removeEffect uses cancelable NeoForge removal admission. If fire-removal is vetoed, fire was still cleared and subsequent ticks can damp motion. Ordinary duration expiration is a separate server-side Expired event path, also cancelable. Frozen onRemoved is glass particles/sound only; the Iaf mixin invokes it at LivingEntity.onEffectRemoved refreshDirtyAttributes, within the native server branch.

Frozen inherits the loader default effect cures; no Frozen-specific cure override exists. removeEffectsCuredBy is server-only, checks the instance cure set and removal event, and removes through ordinary callbacks. Native cure/expiration hooks are preserved; no guaranteed unconditional cleanse is asserted.

ManasCore nested skill MixinLivingEntity declares cancellable HEAD injection into two-argument addEffect. It passes a Changeable instance and source into LIVING_EFFECT_ADDED; false cancels with return false, otherwise replaces the local argument. SkillRegistry.init registers the callback looping learned skill instances, invoking only those passing canInteractSkill; any false onEffectAdded returns interruptFalse. The pinned instance method dispatches virtually to the actual skill. The ColdNullification list extension is the protected tensura_iaf RETURN mixin, adding the Iaf Frozen holder to native Chill/Frost.

ColdNullification inherits ResistSkill.canInteractSkill, overriding the generic TensuraSkill gate: ExistenceStorage sleep mode (positive harvestGiftTick OR harvestTick OR sleepModeTime) rejects; Rest or InfiniteImprisonment rejects; canActivateInArea(instance,entity,-1,false,false) then applies. That call skips worldRestriction checks but can reject a server Player joined to a boss fight banning this ability and toggle it off through restrictUsage. Do not substitute the generic spectator/mastery predicate: the ResistSkill override does not call it. ResistSkill.onEffectAdded admits when not toggled or DISABLE_NULLIFICATION=true; otherwise rejects matching holder in nonempty immune list. The separate canBeToggled method requires mastery>=0 and nullification enabled. Source identity is passed through the callback but unused by this list comparison.

onToggleOn obtains the same immune list and calls TensuraMobEffect.removePredicateEffect. It copies current active effects, matches holders, then ordinary removeEffect; default AP/MP costs are0 and EnergyHelper short-circuits as not out of energy. Removal can be vetoed. The ColdNullification bridge does not add Slowness or MiningFatigue to its list and does not roll them back. Other native skills/hooks can still affect them. Existing statue-recipient veto remains the R2g1 IafHandler declaration, not an implementation change.

Native dragon age tier (getDragonStage, unrelated to TNO Stage) is1 under25days,2 at25,3 at50,4 at75,5 at100. isBaby is tier<2. DragonBase.tick calls superclass, updateDragonCommon, then live server updateDragonServer/updateDragonAttack; server flight-manager update requires isFlying && no controlling passenger. updateDragonCommon stops breathing when fireBreathTicks>ageDays*maxBreathTimeMul (snapshot2), otherwise increments fireBreathTicks and burnProgress to40 when breathing, resets burnProgress when not. isActuallyBreathingFire requires fireBreathTicks>20 and breathing. Sleep/dead and owner-rider fireStopTicks paths can stop server breathing; the source compares getRemainingFireTicks>tier*25, not fireBreathTicks, in its other stop predicate. AI mode randomization remains native.

IceDragon.aiStep server target branch calls shootIceAtMob when groundAttack FIRE and (usingGroundAttack||onGround). The helper accepts ground FIRE or airborne SCORCH_STREAM/HOVER_BLAST state. Ground random1/5 or non-ground HOVER_BLAST selects charge: start FIRECHARGE animation, spawn IceDragonCharge at animation tick15. Otherwise it starts breathing, then after actual-breath gate calls breathAttack(target position,false). Created charge owner is the dragon through constructor->Fireball->AbstractHurtingProjectile.setOwner; server addFreshEntity and head-position relocation are native. Do not replace this with direct manager invocation in a fixture.

With a living target, flight manager HOVER_BLAST calls breathAttack(target position,true); base performChargeAttack starts FIRECHARGE then creates the subtype charge at tick20, head-positioned and server-spawned, then randomizes attacks. This differs from direct IceDragon target/rider tick15 creation. SCORCH_STREAM requires startPreyVec/startAttackVec populated by onSetAttackTarget and calls tryScorchTarget, which waits for actual breathing and aims at target Y plus horizontal progress clamp(fireBreathTicks,0,40)/40 before breathAttack(false). In water, IceDragon manager switches a present-target attack to TACKLE, so that update does not also launch Hover/Scorch breath.

Client native DRAGON_BREATH key calls controller.strike -> control bit3; changed byte sends DragonControlC2SPayload. Server receiver requires nonnull Player, entity passenger-tree membership and dragon.isOwnedBy(player), then sets control byte. updateRider requires a valid controlling passenger and tier>1 before strike starts breathing/calls riderShootFire and sets fireStopTicks10. Controller is first living passenger whose UUID matches nonnull owner UUID, dragon tame, and target!=passenger; getRidingPlayer additionally requires Player. Native riderShootFire random1/5 and !baby chooses tick15 charge along controller look vector; otherwise actual breathing uses COLLIDER/Fluid.NONE ray from rider eyes for10*tier blocks and breathAttack(false). The DreadQueen controller branch is retained as code, not assumed ordinary Player setup; its source attribution uses getRidingPlayer result.

Forge is not deeply cataloged as crafting. Its actual combat collateral route is included: server input ticker, assembled core with canSmelt, lure search AABB+-50 selects first matching dragon type that is chained or tame and passes canSeeInput; assigns burningTarget. canSeeInput compares head-to-ray-hit distance <10+2*width, not strict endpoint MISS. updateBurnTarget additionally requires non-sleeping/non-dead/non-baby, still assembled, squared center distance<115*tier and canPositionBeSeen; calls IceDragon.breathFireAtPos, which waits for actual breath and targets block center via breathAttack(false). Area living damage/Frozen can occur near that forge aim. Recipe/acquisition internals are explicitly excluded.

breathAttack invokes ON_DRAGON_FIRE_BLOCK; any true registered callback cancels helper dispatch. Normal breath stops navigation, aims from head, computes distance=2.5*sqrt(dragon.distanceToSqr(aim)), conqueredDistance=burnProgress/40*distance, increment=ceil(conqueredDistance/100). Invisible sampled positions clip from dragon eyes and server-call destroyAreaBreath at the resulting block position; visible samples only make particles. Once burnProgress>=40 and endpoint visible, server area center is target plus independent [-1.5,1.5) random offsets, floored to BlockPos. canPositionBeSeen accepts clip endpoint distanceSquared<=1 or MISS. Multiple sampled areas can occur per native call; no one-hit-per-breath claim.

destroyAreaBreath first honors ON_DRAGON_DAMAGE_BLOCK cancellation. ICE duration=50*tier ticks; requested damage=tier*attackDamageIce (installed snapshot2.5). Living AABB centered at integer center, half extent3.5 for tier<=3, otherwise2.5+1.2*((x+y+z)*0.333+0.5), x=y=z=2 at tier4 or3 at tier5 (nextInt(1) contributes0). Native default query excludes spectators; then !DragonUtils.onSameTeam, !dragon.is(target), dragon.hasLineOfSight. Hurt return is discarded, then Frozen is attempted. Terrain branch checks mobGriefing/canGrief, but living branch does not depend on terrain changes. LOS requires same level, eye-distance<=128 and COLLIDER/Fluid.NONE MISS.

Only a non-MISS charge collision that survives all early returns and has Dragon owner with DragonUtils.canGrief reaches destroyAreaCharge. Manager again honors ON_DRAGON_DAMAGE_BLOCK and nonnull dragon. ICE Frozen duration400; requested area damage=max(1,tier-1)*2. Default x/y/z half-extents2. When canGrief && mobGriefing and tier>=4, each starts radius2(tier4) or3(tier5)+nextInt(2), then increments once before target AABB (3..4 or4..5). mobGriefing=false leaves half-extents2 and still admits area if outer canGrief true. Targets pass default nonspectator query,!dragon.isAlliedTo,!self,LOS; hurt result discarded then Frozen. canGrief=false suppresses this entire charge area path, but not the earlier direct entity-damage branch. Optional configured explosion is after area/status; snapshot explosiveBreath=false, its complete non-Frozen behavior belongs to later dragon explosion review.

canGrief=false for tame dragon with tamedGriefing=false, otherwise returns global dragon.griefing. Dragon.isAlliedTo returns true for dead model; when tame treats its owner as allied, other TamableAnimal via target.isOwnedBy(owner), other recipients via owner alliance if owner available, else native superclass. DragonUtils.onSameTeam starts from alliance but if both entities (including multipart parents) have nonnull tame owners replaces result by owner1.is(owner2). Manager ICE source has direct=dragon, causing=controlling Player when getRidingPlayer nonnull; otherwise direct=causing=dragon. Charges construct owner=dragon, yet direct impact causeDamage receives CURRENT riding Player if any else dragon and uses direct ICE factory, so direct=causing=that cause, never direct=projectile. Mount changes between launch and impact can change source selection; projectile owner is not reassigned by these hit paths.

DragonCharge.tick uses super.baseTick, not AbstractHurtingProjectile.tick. Server processing requires owner null or owner.isAlive and loaded current chunk; failed gate discards. It obtains ProjectileUtil move-vector collision then directly calls onHit for non-MISS, without its superclass tick impact-event/deflection routing. Native geometric helper clips blocks, then finds nearest admitted entity before the block. canHitMob requires target!=this, superclass canHitEntity (alive/pickable, owner/leftOwner/shared-vehicle predicate), nonnull owner, !target.isAlliedTo(owner), and not DragonPartEntity. Own class isPickable=false and hurt always false; no own attack-reflection implementation. External changes are not certified. Null owner therefore cannot pass entity filter and cannot yield dragon area on block hit.

Server entity hit: IDragonProjectile returns; Dragon owner alliance/self/its multipart returns. For entity!=owner with Dragon owner, any TamableAnimal then tests shootingDragon.isOwnedBy(shootingDragon.getOwner()) and returns if true. Exact native TamableAnimal.isOwnedBy is reference equality to getOwner, including null==null. Thus ordinary stable-owner evaluation rejects ANY TamableAnimal entity collision here, not merely a same-owner target. This occurs before removal, direct hurt and area; a prior ally filter may reject even earlier. Do not silently repair the apparent native predicate. Otherwise randomize attacks and discard (without returning), then surviving entity!=owner branch checks another shared-owner predicate and calls causeDamage/current-rider selection, requested direct damage=attackDamageIce*tier. Hurt boolean is discarded; living HP==0 triggers another attack randomization. Discard does not itself stop following area dispatch. Non-MISS block hit has no direct entity hurt, but can area damage/Frozen. Direct entity hit adds no Frozen by itself.

Native HP damage, Frozen status, vanilla weapon companion effects, terrain grief and optional explosion are separate attempts with different predicates. A denied damage hurt can still be followed by Frozen in manager areas; a rejected projectile collision cannot. A Frozen immunity can reject status without erasing native HP damage. No generic percent HP/SHP loss is inferred from requested damage. R2g1 damage identity/tags and R2g2a native add/removal/ColdNullification rules remain authoritative.

Future static-derived setup only (not executed): native live tier>=2 IceDragon, native target/attack AI or legitimate owner rider breath input, distinct non-Tamable non-allied living target, same-level LOS, loaded collision area, no event veto; enable grief for charge variant. Observe real projectile/area callbacks and Frozen holder rather than invoking a helper/fabricating damage. Contrast breath with canGrief=false, charge with canGrief=false, mobGriefing=false, TamableAnimal collision, native cold-null toggle and creative target. Protect all native owner, damage and effect predicates.

These are independent air-resource writes, not HP/SHP damage or custom drowning DamageType. Native later drowning remains source/admission authority. Selected native discoveries, quoted from the current canonical record:

**`br:roll_resource`** — `CUSTOM_RESOURCE`.

Native client rising-edge Dodge Roll key (default keycode90) sends DodgeRollMessage(type0,left,forward) and calls local pressAction for prediction. Registered payload handler processes only SERVERBOUND, queues work with context.player (no arbitrary target player), then pressAction. Actual server pressAction requires nonempty current chunk, type0, config CAN_USE_ROLL true, not swimming, an available charge with cooldown<=0, and successful startRoll. startRoll independently requires roll<=-5 and onGround. No native spectator/creative/gear/boss-presence predicate is added here. Native registered networking and event annotations are pinned; actual runtime delivery/sync is untested.

Constructor starts roll0, duration14, no charge entries. PlayerTickEvent.Post calls tick; every tick charge capacity is max(0, configured DEFAULT_ROLL_COUNT + integer ROLL_COUNT attribute). Default capacity2, native syncable attribute default0 range0..9. Newly added slots start0; removed slots are removeLast after prior sorting. Successful start resets rollDuration14 and roll14, then caller sets used cooldown1 and sorts. isRolling is roll>0; isInvulnerable is strictly roll>7, i.e. counter values14..8 only. Counter decrements one per Post until-5, including5tick recovery after roll0. These are method counter windows, not a promise of wall-clock invulnerability independent of event order.

Only when roll already<=-5 does tick subtract1/ROLL_COOLDOWN from the first positive cooldown and stop; charge recovery is sequential, paused through active roll/recovery. Default configured40; negative config sets firstpositive0, zero uses native float division (no added clamp). ROLL_COOLDOWN_MORE default20 exists but has zero GETSTATIC consumers anywhere in installed artifact, so do not invent per-extra-charge delay. Charges/duration/cooldown are native resources with no Stage value. Equipment ROLL_COUNT producers are indexed for later equipment review; no uncalled attribute helper is promoted as a working delivery.

Only other installed direct RollAttachment.isInvulnerable consumer is Yeti GlacialShove: ServerPlayer in its native zone is skipped while roll>7. That is a separate explicit displacement/status gate, not evidence ordinary knockback is canceled everywhere; full Yeti producer/geometry is pending. Attachment serialization retains direction,duration,roll,count and each cooldown; registry uses AttachmentType.serializable. Do not synthesize/clear saved state. Death-copy/synchronization behavior is not assumed from serialization alone.

Selected native discoveries, quoted from the current canonical record:

**`bomd:shared_admission`** — `BINARY_MECHANIC`.

BaseEntity.hurt captures a handler reference and EntityStats wrapper. Server: all beforeDamage hooks run first; then handler.shouldDamage(this,source,amount) short-circuits super.hurt when false; afterDamage runs server-side with the original source and requested amount and the boolean result even when admission rejected or super returned false. shouldDamage itself is not server-gated. With no handler, it directly uses super.hurt. The wrapper stores the LivingEntity, not an immutable HP snapshot: getHealth/getMaxHealth read current native values. This layer does not multiply damage, rewrite sources or directly subtract HP.

CompositeDamageHandler preserves supplied order for all beforeDamage and all afterDamage callbacks. shouldDamage stops at the first false handler. Thus a rejecting inner handler does not prevent the outer before/after notifications. Actual installed order: Lich phase detector, targetless-attacker callback, LichMoveLogic, DamageMemory; Obsidilith move logic, ShieldDamageHandler, DamageMemory; Gauntlet hitbox helper, goal handler, DamageMemory; VoidBlossom HP detector, composite hitbox handlers, DamageMemory. Concrete handler predicates belong to their boss family.

Selected native discoveries, quoted from the current canonical record:

**`cataclysm:abyssal_fear`** — `CUSTOM_STATUS`.

Abyssal Fear is harmful and its own tick does no damage. BlockHeal cancels LivingHealEvent whenever recipient has Fear, irrespective of heal amount/amplifier/source and without a new duration/amplifier scaling rule. Native LivingEntity.heal passes through EventHooks.onLivingHeal before adding HP, so normal healing, Regeneration and boss heal calls are subject to this veto. Direct native setHealth state changes such as Cursium rebirth do not route through heal. Do not describe Fear as blocking every possible HP increase or bypass its veto with a fallback.

Remaining native ambiguities: **0** in the accepted ledger scope. Stage policy, full-pack runtime interactions and unexecuted future fixtures remain outside this static completion. Older provisional family queues and checkpoint-specific “next” instructions are historical and do not reopen the completed review.

Selected native discoveries, quoted from the current canonical record:

**`tensura_neb:carrion_aura_slash_producer`** — `CUSTOM_DAMAGE`.

Owned AuraSlash carries Aura Slash skill and damage=attack, noGravity=true. Base horizontal placement radius2, eyeY-0.5; positive multishot offset uses angle +145 or -145 degrees and source-dependent offset, shoots with horizontal-distance*0.2 vertical compensation; otherwise shootToward directly. Both speed1,inaccuracy0. Local AI calls one slash for swing, and three distinct offsets0.1/0.6/0.6 for talon. Inherited impact and block-cut behavior are separate contracts.

Remaining unknowns: exact original ManasCore pin and all four external obligation groups. All local census methods are reconciled; 44 records do not certify inherited behavior. [tensura_neb-dependency-obligations.json](benchmarks/external-effects-catalog/tensura_neb-dependency-obligations.json).

Selected native discoveries, quoted from the current canonical record:

**`alexscaves:sugar_rush`** — `CUSTOM_CONTROL`.

The registered native MOVEMENT_SPEED template uses alexscaves:sugar_rush_speed, coefficient0.25 and ADD_MULTIPLIED_TOTAL; original template creation multiplies by amplifier+1. Every positive-duration tick returns true. Client tick requests only native sound; server tick preserves X/Z and multiplies ascending Y by0.85 or descending Y by0.45. Only the descending arm, when Slow Falling is absent, requests native Slow Falling10/0 with ambient/visible/icon allfalse; addEffect return is discarded. No damage or original effect-owner lookup occurs. With sugarRushSlowsTime enabled, an Added event for a Player with SugarRush passes ceil(float(nativeDuration)*2F) and the same2F to enterSlowMotion. ServerLevel-only helper searches Citadel LocalEntityTickRateModifiers by entity ID; the first matching modifier has only maxDuration updated, then returns. Otherwise it submits a new modifier with original player ID/type, third double argument10D, current dimension, supplied duration and supplied float. Exact Citadel2.7.6 proves radius10 and multiplier2 with maxDuration in master ticks; the five-contract dependency registry records the exact applicability, configured hook limits and transport. Expiration requests leaveSlowMotion only for Player/SugarRush/configtrue; explicit Remove has only the original exit sound, no leave call. Dimension travel requests leave whenever the Player still has SugarRush, without a config check or destination substitution. Leave searches the full list and removes only the last matching local modifier. No new type/rate/dimension filter is added to either search. Player RETURN injections with configtrue, SugarRush and native proxy-active gate multiply original getSpeed by3F; getFlyingSpeed returns this.getSpeed()*0.5F rather than multiplying original flying speed. Native proxy compares server tick-length return with50 or client tracker return with50F. isTimeModificationValid returnsfalse only for a LocalEntityTickRateModifier when this Player lacks SugarRush. Exact dependency controller resolves player validity, strict radius and duration/rate transport. LOCAL_ENTITY alone leaves server tick-length50, so this native server proxy gate is false for SugarRush alone. The active Citadel client Pre tick writes a200ms query for one valid multiplier2 (local factor appears twice); inactive server/entity mixins are not inferred into effective server slowdown. Native update/remove does not sync existing client copies. Native original potion definitions supply {'potion_regular_duration': 1800, 'potion_long_duration': 3600} to this existing effect holder; native potion delivery/lifecycle retains original source admission. No duplicate effect callback. Shared proxy tick-rate query uses Citadel ServerTickRateTracker.getServerTickLengthMs()!=50/server and ClientTickRateTracker.getClientTickRate()!=50F/client. These native API queries and ClientEvents hand-pose clock are independently captured. Exact Citadel2.7.6 execution and configured-hook limits are resolved in alexscaves-citadel-dependency-obligations.json; this native protocol refinement supplies no second speed/duration formula.

**`lm:ambusher`** — `CUSTOM_DAMAGE`.

IAnimatedMob with health 50, armor 6, knockback resistance .5, follow range 14, movement .1 and damage 8; configured full-health multiplier, XP 2 and persistence. Attack 0->2->0 max 15/look 48/range 3.5; attack tick 8 area radius 4/height 3/arc 150/base 8*AmbusherDamageMultiplier, only the current target, excluding Ambushers/self/allies; wrapped-angle distance precedence retained. Rejects configured direct AbstractArrow, FALL and TRIDENT. Collision escape adds (.1,0,.1); aim overwrites body yaw with pitch. Die adds three Spikebugs without its own server guard, attempts AIR item drop, then parent death state 3. Server nonsilent death handling stops AI after tick 1 and removes exactly at 20; silent instances do not reach removal through this override. ## Important mechanics established by the research

These are selected findings with exact native details. Full contracts, delivery variants and method coordinates are in each linked canonical review.

| Target | Important finding | Canonical record / evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Cult of Azazel | Manipulation retargets Piglin/ZombifiedPiglin around affected players on duration-mod-20 server ticks; the client also changes view/input. Stick pull applies Manipulation 600/0 and requested velocity (horizontal factor 1.4, Y 0.4); motion has no addEffect-success gate. | `cultofazazel:manipulation` / `cultofazazel:stick_pull` |
| Variants & Ventures | Gelid assigns frozen ticks to 240. Melee and owned-snowball admission differ; the snowball requests 4 thrown-source damage and sets the timer independently of hurt success. A frozen-timer assignment is not a fixed-duration stun. Poison payload is 100 ticks / amplifier 0. | `variantsandventures:frozen_ticks_set` / `variantsandventures:poison_payload` |

## 5. Implementation and workflow history

### Production, research instrumentation and generic extraction are distinct

Production integration begins with Royal Bow GearExistence, progresses through the Stage/family wrappers and the bounded Magic/Holy endgame layer, and is accepted through the phase-specific tests above. Development observation code records native flow and corrects experiment fixtures; it is not automatically a production feature. External-catalog extraction/class readers, finite queues, semantic assembly and audits operate on static evidence under research protections.

The complete chronicle in section 8 lists **every changed implementation/build/script path** for each reachable commit, identifies added versus modified test files, and links changed receipts. Where no checkpoint result is recorded for a commit, its individual validation outcome is **unknown**; an added test or successful commit is not a test PASS. Later acceptance applies only to the documented final scope.

### Research execution architecture and checkpoint changes

The first discovery tool had five class-reader tests, including JDK disassembler cross-checks for switches/wide locals/invokedynamic/interface calls/multidimensional arrays, modified UTF-8 and malformed class/opcode rejection. The broad scan prepares candidates and readable aids; it does not classify native behavior.

Canonical per-mod reviews became the source for deterministic effect/source/delivery/vanilla/primitive projections. Numeric candidates later require original native identity, exact consumer binding and explicit alias/derived-summary handling. Recorded candidate counts of zero in some older completed reviews mean no candidates were retained under that catalog representation; they do not prove the code has no numerical parameters.

Cataclysm integrity repair corrected source schema/reference/classification defects and retired obsolete promotion builders while retaining native facts. Subsequent ArPhEx/AlexCaves/AlexMobs native context, forwarding, presentation-access and full-owner field proofs reduce structural work. Exact finite dispositions require authored contracts/exclusions; a presentation name or structural group does not establish an exclusion.

Recovery commits and session stop statements preserve state safely. Later authorized continuations supersede only the applicable session stop; old reports retain their checkpoint-local instructions. Completed mod reviews remain locked. Current root `AGENTS.md` provides the compact execution map and isolation/protection requirements.

At documentation preparation, `git diff dc08cda002029695ff1acc18ce8ed44f0f8ae90f -- src build.gradle gradle.properties settings.gradle` is empty. This verifies the current research continuation against its production baseline; it does not erase earlier accepted Phase 6 implementation history.

Historical large-campaign protection also names `eb37f0bfc0e7aa863632f163881566c0ae2a8701`. Alex’s closure preserves the already-existing four source deletions against that older baseline; they were present at the safe handoff. Treat that retained delta separately from new production edits. Documentation publication stages only documentation files and preserves the existing worktree research changes.

## Archive limits and preservation rules

- This archive describes available Git/evidence history. Pre-repository motivation and unnamed earlier phases are unknown.
- Current immutable research ancestry and explicitly linked tooling-branch workflow reports are the inspected scope. A historic branch name in a report is not a current live branch claim. The live research branch was separately verified.
- Reports preserve their fixture/source/loader authority. Completed static research does not prove Minecraft runtime behavior, every pack override, multiplayer, sustained balance or future Stage eligibility.
- Historical raw-capture absences, incomplete discovery indexes and stale summary fields remain visible. They do not justify reconstructing exact missing behavior or claiming present blockers already closed by later receipts.
- Production changes, test additions and benchmark-harness changes are traceable through the full implementation chronicle. Results without recorded validation remain unknown.
- Local checkpoint snapshots are documentary preservation. The original uncommitted work, canonical views and completed reviews remain unchanged by this publication.
- No token/allowance/time savings are invented. Returned bytes, native method/witness counts and exact recorded test outcomes are the only stated measurements.
